# IRunner.ItemUsesLeft property

The uses left of the item it holds: 3, 2 or 1 for the triple box and the triple rockets, 1 for the game's other items, from 1 to its [`MaxUses`](../../ModRunners.Api.Items/IModItem/MaxUses.md) for a mod item, and 0 when it holds none.
